sources.title: NeurIPS Poster Leak-CURBER: A Leakage-Controlled Multimodal Evaluation ...
sources.snippet: We present Leak-CURBER, the largest multimodal, leakage-controlled benchmark for evaluating machine learning and deep learning models for enzymatic reactions. Leak-CURBER standardizes data from 10 biochemical databases and curates datasets with multimodal inputs, metrics, and leakage-controlled splits for 4 tasks.
